transcript.message: You moved invoice 4471 to cost center CC-200. What made you choose CC-200 instead of CC-100?
The vendor is in the marketing division so it belongs to CC-200 not CC-100. You always match the vendor department to the correct cost center.
You put invoice 4472 on hold. What triggered that decision?

The invoice amount was 12500 but the purchase order only authorized 11200. Any discrepancy over 5% goes on hold and gets sent back to the vendor for correction. You never approve an invoice that exceeds the PO amount by more than 5 percent without explicit manager approval.
You escalated invoice 4473 to tier-2 approval and assigned J.Martinez. Why does this one need tier-2?

Anything over 10000 dollars requires tier-2 sign-off. J.Martinez is the designated approver for the operations department. I always check the approver list before assigning to make sure the person is still active.
